newsitem.title: FINLAND: POLAR DOES NOT SEE 97 EARNINGS IMPROVEMENT.
newsitem.headline: POLAR DOES NOT SEE 97 EARNINGS IMPROVEMENT.

text.p: Finnish construction group Polar-yhtyma Oy said on Wednesday it did not expect full-year 1997 earnings to improve on 1996.
"The Polar group's overall financial result for 1997 is not expected to be an improvement on last year's," Polar said in a statement with its January-April results.
It said construction activities had posted a loss in the first four months and the financial performance of the real estate business had weakened compared to the year-ago period.
In 1996, Polar made a 54 million markka operating profit but a 40 million markka loss before extras and tax.
